jobs.description:
**Volontariat (CEV) | 6 mois | Novembre 2026**

## Acted

***Qui sommes-nous***

Acted travaille avec 19 millions de personnes dans 43 pays au carrefour de l’humanitaire, du développement, et des programmes climatiques et environnementaux. Grâce à une connaissance poussée des contextes et l’adoption de technologies émergentes, nous sauvons des vies, allégeons les souffrances, et protégeons et restaurons notre planète. Travaillant avec un écosystème croissant de partenaires locaux, nationaux et internationaux, nous poursuivons un objectif commun : un monde 3Zéro : Zéro Exclusion, Zéro Carbone, Zéro Pauvreté.

***Qui cherchons-nous***

Vous apportez les compétences clefs attendues d’un travailleur humanitaire et de développement, mais également une conscience climatique et environnementale active, et vous pouvez naviguez les défis qui émergent lorsque les souffrances environnementale et humaine se rencontrent. Vous avez l’esprit entrepreneurial : vous décelez les opportunités, connectez les points, adaptez votre approche aux différents environnements, et vous prenez des risques mesurés dans la poursuite de résultats. Vous alliez les principes au pragmatisme, et l’ambition à l’humilité.

## Acted République Démocratique du Congo

La République Démocratique du Congo fait face à une crise humanitaire prolongée, marquée par la persistance des conflits armés, des déplacements massifs de populations, des chocs climatiques et des chocs épidémiques récurrents, tels que le choléra, le mpox ou la rougeole. Ces dynamiques combinées affectent durablement les conditions de vie des populations déplacées, retournées et hôtes, en particulier dans les provinces de l’Est et certaines zones de l’Ouest du pays.

Dans ce contexte, Acted intervient principalement dans les provinces du Sud-Kivu, Nord-Kivu, Tanganyika, Nord-Ubangi et Sud-Ubangi, à travers des projets financés notamment par le Department of State / US, ECHO, FCDO, SDC, le Fonds Humanitaire, ainsi que le CDCS, afin de répondre aux besoins humanitaires immédiats et aux vulnérabilités persistantes des populations les plus affectées. Afin de renforcer la couverture et la complémentarité de ses interventions, Acted intervient en coordination avec plusieurs partenaires opérationnels, et est membre de consortiums humanitaires.

Cette coordination permet à Acted de mettre en œuvre des réponses d’urgence rapides et multisectorielles pour couvrir les besoins vitaux liés aux conflits, aux déplacements forcés, aux catastrophes naturelles et aux crises sanitaires. Les interventions portent notamment sur l’assistance alimentaire, les abris et articles ménagers essentiels, l’Eau, Hygiène et Assainissement (EHA), la gestion et coordination des sites (CCCM) ainsi que l’éducation en situation d’urgence, avec une attention particulière portée, dès le premier kilomètre humanitaire, à la protection et à la dignité des personnes vulnérables. Au Sud-Kivu, Acted est par ailleurs un acteur clé du Mécanisme de Réponse Rapide (RRM), contribuant à des réponses rapides et coordonnées en lien avec les déplacements de populations et aux chocs soudains.

En parallèle, Acted développe des interventions visant à renforcer la résilience des communautés, à travers le soutien aux moyens d’existence, la relance agricole, la sécurité alimentaire et la relance économique locale, afin de réduire la vulnérabilité face aux chocs récurrents.

Acted apporte également un appui structurant aux organisations de la société civile (OSC) en renforçant leurs capacités organisationnelles et opérationnelles. Cet accompagnement inclut l’appui à la structuration des initiatives locales ainsi que la mise en place de mécanismes de financement en cascade, permettant aux OSC de développer des activités directement liées aux problématiques locales et aux priorités identifiées par les communautés.

Enfin, Acted intègre progressivement dans ses programmes des approches sensibles à l’environnement, visant à la préservation des écosystèmes et des aires protégées, à la réduction de l’empreinte environnementale des interventions et à la promotion de solutions à faible émission de carbone. À travers l’appui aux communautés, Acted encourage le développement d’activités génératrices de revenus durables et d’une économie locale plus verte, contribuant à la protection des ressources naturelles tout en renforçant les moyens d’existence.

## Rôle et responsabilités principales

Sous l’autorité du responsable finances pays, le volontaire finances sera chargé d’assister l’équipe pays finances sur le contrôle financier interne de la mission. Plus spécifiquement il sera en charge de la vérification et du recoupement des données comptables (PRATIC), de la gestion financière et des outils de contrôle des données (TITANIC).

***Principales responsabilités***

1\. Contribuer à la conformité comptable d’Acted

2\. Contrôle des outils mensuels de reporting

- *Révision comptable*
- *Revue finances*
- *Contrôle des coûts*
- *RH suivi*

3\. Apporter son aide aux tâches quotidiennes

## Qualifications et compétences requises

- Master en Finance, Audit, Business Management ou équivalent ;
- Compétences en finance et comptabilité ;
- Maîtrise de Microsoft Office, en particulier de Microsoft Excel (maîtrise des principales formules de gestion de base de données) ;
- Capacités à prendre des responsabilités et à travailler sous pression ;
- Excellentes qualités de communication, excellentes qualités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais ;
- Maîtrise totale du Pack Office.

## Termes de référence

Pour plus d'informations sur le poste, [cliquez ici ](https://www.acted.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/cfv-rdc-2026.pdf).

## Conditions

Statut : volontaire (convention de stage non obligatoire)

- Living allowance de 300 USD
- Logement en guesthouse et nourriture pris en charge par Acted
- Sécurité sociale, mutuelle (MSH) et assistance rapatriement (SOS International) pris en charge par Acted
- Transport vers la mission et billet retour totalement pris en charge (vers l’adresse spécifiée sur le contrat de travail)
- Frais de visa pris en charge par Acted
- Une semaine de préparation au départ comprenant 4 jours de formation sécurité en immersion
- Soutien psychologique (rendez-vous avec un.e professionnel.le)
- Ce poste est classé comme un poste international dans la grille de recrutement d’Acted. L’éligibilité à un contrat international est donc requise.

jobs.title: Oficial de Recuperación Económica - Carúpano
jobs.description:
El Consejo Dánes para refugiados es una de las ONG humanitarias líderes en el mundo, que trabaja en más de 40 países para brindar asistencia y protección adecuadas a refugiados, solicitantes de asilo, desplazados internos, retornados, personas en movimiento y población local vulnerable/comunidades de acogida. Actualmente, DRC está buscando un Oficial de Recuperación Económica altamente calificado con sede en Carúpano Estado Sucre, Venezuela.

**Acerca del trabajo:**

DRC está administrando sus operaciones en Venezuela, bajo la dirección de la oficina de país en Caracas y tres oficinas de campo ubicadas en los estados de Sucre, Apure y Zulia. DRC Venezuela está implementando actividades como monitoreo de protección, asistencia legal, asistencia de protección individual para PWSN, sesiones informativas para PoC, prevención de trata de personas, rehabilitación de infraestructura de salud y seguridad alimentaria.

**Descripción general del cargo**

Bajo la supervisión de la Gerencia de Recuperación Económica, el Oficial de Recuperación Económica apoyará en la implementación operativa del proyecto en terreno, facilitando la ejecución técnica de las actividades de **seguridad alimentaria y medios de vida (SAMV)**, asegurando la transversalización de la protección y garantizando la calidad, participación y rendición de cuentas durante todo el proceso. El/la Oficial de recuperación económica garantizará que se desarrollen todas las actividades del plan de acción y se compilen todos los medios de verificación para la adecuada entrega. Adicionalmente, mantendrá buena comunicación con los miembros del equipo y garantizará el buen desarrollo del personal a su cargo.

**Responsabilidades:**

**Implementación técnica y logística:**

- Apoyar en la planificación, organización y supervisión de jornadas de Distribución General de Alimentos.
- Verificar las condiciones de seguridad, accesibilidad y dignidad del sitio de distribución, garantizando el estricto cumplimiento de los protocolos humanitarios y los estándares de donantes.
- Garantizar la adecuada recepción, conciliación, distribución y registro de los paquetes alimentarios y ayudas humanitarias a la población objetivo.
- Coordinar junto al equipo de logística y protección el desarrollo de las actividades del proyecto, tales como la distribución de asistencia, aplicación de encuestas de seguridad alimentaria, desarrollo de talleres comunitarios y evaluaciones de necesidades en el terreno.
- Coordinar con el equipo de protección el acompañamiento de las actividades en el territorio para asegurar un enfoque de "No Hacer Daño" (Do No Harm).
- Garantizar la transversalización de la protección, el género y la inclusión en todas las entregas de asistencia alimentaria, acorde con los lineamientos establecidos por la organización y el donante.
- Realizar diagnósticos socioeconómicos y evaluaciones de seguridad alimentaria a personas de interés y comunidades vulnerables identificadas en terreno.
- Elaborar planes de mejora individualizados enfocados en el fortalecimiento, la diversificación o la reactivación de los medios de vida y la resiliencia comunitaria.
- Coordinar y entregar apoyos en especie (como insumos productivos, herramientas, equipos, etc.) de acuerdo con las necesidades identificadas y los planes de reactivación económica.
- Otras actividades necesarias para la correcta implementación y el cumplimiento de las metas del proyecto.

**Participación comunitaria:**

- Facilitar procesos de información transparente, convocatoria oportuna y participación de la comunidad que permitan el acceso seguro y una sólida aceptación comunitaria.
- Monitorear la participación y accesibilidad de grupos vulnerables (mujeres, personas mayores, personas con discapacidad) a los puntos de distribución, identificando y mitigando barreras específicas.
- Garantizar la difusión y el acceso de la comunidad a los Mecanismos de Quejas, Reclamos y Retroalimentación (FCRM) de la organización y del donante durante las actividades.
- Apoyar a su referente técnico y Gerente de Base en la realización de mapeos de actores clave y posibles aliados institucionales o comunitarios en las zonas de interés

**Monitoreo y reporte**

- Garantizar la recopilación oportuna y el resguardo de los medios de verificación requeridos (listas de asistencia, actas de entrega, registros fotográficos) y datos cualitativos del proyecto.
- Levantar reportes diarios de distribución, incidencias logísticas, alertas de protección y necesidades detectadas en el terreno.
- Monitorear el avance socioeconómico de las personas beneficiarias, documentar resultados y generar lecciones aprendidas sobre la seguridad alimentaria del hogar.
- Aportar a la documentación de buenas prácticas, historias de vida o casos de éxito enfocados en la recuperación de la autonomía alimentaria y económica.

**Experiencia y competencias técnicas:**

- Mínimo 2 años de experiencia comprobable y relevante en trabajo humanitario dentro de ONGs u otras organizaciones sin fines de lucro.
- Experiencia demostrada en la implementación de actividades de medios de vida, apoyo económico, emprendimiento o desarrollo comunitario.
- Experiencia operativa en intervenciones de emergencia, gestión de puntos de distribución y entrega de asistencia alimentaria (GFD) y no alimentaria (NFI).
- Experiencia de trabajo directo con comunidades urbanas, rurales y/o indígenas en contextos de vulnerabilidad social.
- Excelente capacidad de comunicación asertiva, empatía y relaciones interpersonales con poblaciones diversas.
- Habilidades de redacción y escritura por encima del promedio, con capacidad para elaborar informes de distribución concisos y de alta calidad.
- Excelente dominio de MS Word, PowerPoint y nivel intermedio/avanzado de MS Excel para el manejo y filtrado de datos.
- Experiencia en el manejo, depuración y control de calidad de bases de datos de beneficiarios (deseable conocimiento en plataformas de registro humanitario como Kobo Toolbox o similares).

**Educación**:

- Profesional o técnico en ciencias sociales, nutrición, psicología, trabajo social o afines.

**Ofrecemos:**

- La oportunidad de pertenecer a una de las mejores ONG's a nivel mundial.
- Acceso a más de 1,000 capacitaciones y certificados en línea gratuita
- Duración del contrato: 3 meses (Renovable sujeto a fondos y desempeño)
- Categoría del Empleo: Banda H
- Seguro HCM únicamente para el trabajador.

**Competencias Básicas de DRC:**

- **Lograr la excelencia**: centrarse en alcanzar resultados y garantizar procesos eficientes.
- **Colaboración:** involucrar a las partes relevantes y alentar la retroalimentación.
- **Tomar la iniciativa**: tomar posesión e iniciativa mientras se busca la innovación.
- **Comunicar:** escuchar y hablar con eficacia y honestidad.
- **Demostración de integridad**: actuar de acuerdo con la visión y los valores de DRC.

**Proceso de solicitud:** Todos los solicitantes deben cargar una carta de presentación (máx. 1 página) y un CV actualizado (**máx. 2 páginas, sin soportes**) en español, en la plataforma de empleo de DRC. Las solicitudes enviadas por correo electrónico no serán consideradas.

**Fecha de cierre de solicitudes**: Domingo 01 de noviembre a las 11:59 pm Hora Local. Tenga en cuenta que las solicitudes se revisarán continuamente y las entrevistas se planificarán tan pronto como se identifique a un candidat@ adecuado. DRC se reserva el derecho a cerrar la vacante antes de la fecha límite una vez se identifique a un candidato idóneo.

**Fecha de inicio:** noviembre 2026

jobs.title: Associate, Malaria and NTDs
jobs.description:
## **Overview**

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work: [http://www.clintonhealthaccess.org](http://www.clintonhealthaccess.org/).

*CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.*

**Position Overview**

Your responsibilities will involve supporting the malaria program in scaling up interventions to effectively reduce the disease burden in Angola. The selected candidate will be responsible for a wide range of tasks, from conducting quantitative and qualitative analyses, to designing data-driven strategic plans, to providing operational support to ensure the execution of effective, high-impact programs. The Associate will develop and maintain strong relationships with CHAI teams supporting the malaria program, as well as with relevant government, technical, and implementing partners. They will also identify areas for intervention related to improvements in vector control, surveillance, and program implementation, and be able to initiate work plans to address these issues quickly and with limited guidance.

The candidate must have excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and project management skills, as well as strong cultural sensitivity and emotional intelligence. The selected candidate must embody CHAI's values, including resourcefulness, patience, tenacity, humility, independence, frugality, and a strong work ethic.

The position will be based in Luanda, with frequent travel to Angola's provinces and occasional international travel.

## **Responsibilities**

- Provide technical assistance to the national malaria program to refine malaria control interventions.
- Support the development and monitoring of government strategies, roadmaps, and costed work plans.
- Work with CHAI colleagues and government counterparts to assess strategies, identify and prioritize resource gaps, and develop new funding proposals for the country.
- Contribute to the drafting, review, and feedback of technical products, which may include strategic plans, guidelines, grant proposals, donor reports, or implementation updates.
- Contribute to the design and execution of monitoring and evaluation to measure progress toward malaria control objectives (analysis of key indicators, design, and execution of monitoring and evaluation of surveillance platforms, etc.).
- Monitor program activities against project objectives and donor commitments, identify bottlenecks or operational shortcomings, and work collaboratively with national and global CHAI teams to achieve exceptional results within tight timelines.
- Identify new opportunities within and beyond the project's initial scope, anticipate risks, and be proactive in responding to them.
- Support the drafting of programmatic reports for government and donors, as well as concept notes or other external communication products.
- Perform any other duties requested by management.

## **Qualifications**

- Professional fluency in Portuguese and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
- Bachelor's degree and two to three years of relevant professional experience.
- High level of proficiency in the MS Office suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
- Ability to work independently and autonomously, balancing multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to deliver persuasive presentations and reports.
- Ability to think strategically while maintaining strong organizational skills and a detail-oriented approach.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and set priorities.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships in a multicultural environment.
- Willingness to travel frequently (30-50 percent of the time), including occasional travel to rural areas.

**Preferred qualifications**

- A master's degree or postgraduate qualification.
- Prior knowledge of malaria control and infectious diseases.
- Experience working in resource-limited settings, particularly in Angola.
- Fluency in at least one relevant local language.
- Prior experience working in fast-paced, results-oriented environments, such as consulting, management, investment banking, or industry.
- Experience working and communicating with government officials, multilateral organizations, or development donors.
- Experience working remotely with a decentralized/remote team.
- Experience working in developing-country contexts.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work: [http://www.clintonhealthaccess.org](http://www.clintonhealthaccess.org/).

*CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.*

**Role Overview**

CHAI is seeking an exceptional, entrepreneurial leader to serve as Program Manager, Malaria & NTDs in Angola. The Program Manager holds overall responsibility for CHAI’s malaria and NTD strategy, operations, and programmatic impact in Angola and serves as CHAI’s most senior representative in-country. This individual will build and sustain trusted relationships with national and county government, donors, and partners, while leading a high-performing, multi-program team through a complex and dynamic operating environment. The Program Manager will shape the long-term vision for CHAI’s malaria and NTD portfolio, working with the Angola National Malaria Control Programme donors, regional and global CHAI programs, and senior leadership to build partnerships and chart a path to lasting impact.

## **Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership and Program Management**

- Define the national team's overall strategy, develop clear operational plans for execution, and continuously identify opportunities for CHAI to add value and maximize impact.
- Maintain a profound understanding of health system priorities and gaps at the national and provincial levels, and ensure effective implementation and long-term sustainability of CHAI Angola's malaria program areas.
- Lead program design and expansion in partnership with government, and guide each program toward scale and sustainable impact.
- Ensure rigorous design, execution, and monitoring and evaluation, so program results meet or exceed commitments to donors.
- Given CHAI's lean staffing model, take on direct programmatic work where needed to support the country team.
- Proactively identify impactful opportunities for CHAI technical support across multiple disease areas.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Communication**

- Elevate CHAI's role as a trusted partner and adviser to the Angola Ministry of Health, relevant stakeholders, and safeguard CHAI's reputation as a highly capable organization whose primary agenda is to support government priorities.
- Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across national and county government, international agencies, NGOs, the private sector, and donors.
- Develop communication materials, deliver presentations, and represent CHAI in public fora.
- Maintain strong bidirectional communication with CHAI regional and global leadership to ensure CHAI's full capabilities are leveraged on the ground.

**Resource Mobilization and Donor Relations**

- Support fundraising efforts, including the development of new programs and the management of relationships with existing and potential donors.
- Represent CHAI externally with partners, and at national and international fora.

**Team Development**

- Lead the Angola malaria and NTD team of about 6 people to consistently deliver transformational impact within Angola’s malaria and NTD programming.
- Build and maintain cohesive, effective, and high-performing teams to support new and existing programs.
- Undertake other responsibilities as assigned by Manager or CHAI leadership.

## **Qualifications**

- A Bachelor or Master's degree plus 7+ years of working experience with increasing levels of responsibility and leadership
- Fluent written/spoken English and Portuguese
- Experience working in an international context and/or entrepreneurial environment
- Exceptional analytical (qualitative and quantitative) and communication (written, oral, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving) skills
- Ability to think strategically and anticipate future consequences and trends
- Ability to work well both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
- People-management skills: experience with directly line-managing employees to support professional development and ensure quality outputs from the team
- Ability to be effective, calm, and flexible in a fast-paced work environment, to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and to effectively prioritize
- Experience and willingness to work in unstable and ever-changing, developing settings
- Strong work ethic, integrity, credibility, and dedication to CHAI’s mission
- High level of proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
- Ability to travel up to 20% in-country as needed

**Advantages**

- Experience in different roles (i.e., country and global) within CHAI
- Experience working in management consulting, investment banking, or similar fast-paced, output-oriented environments
- Experience working in health system strengthening and/or healthcare worker engagement
- Experience working in developing countries, particularly on health-related initiatives
- Experience working in pharmaceutical or medical device market research, market intelligence, wholesale distribution, or commercial strategy
- Knowledge of major global infectious disease problems
- Experience working with governments and institutions in sub-Saharan Africa

jobs.title: Programs Assistant
jobs.description:
**ORGANIZATION DESCRIPTION**

Established in 1951, Amideast is an American nonprofit organization dedicated to creating hope, opportunity, and mutual understanding among people in the Middle East, North Africa, and United States through life-changing opportunities for education and cultural exchanges. Working with local, regional, and international partners, we provide programs and services that improve educational opportunity and quality, expand access to U.S. study, empower youth and women, strengthen local institutions, and develop language and professional skills for success in the global economy. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., Amideast operates offices in 11 countries in the MENA region. For more information, visit us at [http://www.amideast.org](http://www.amideast.org)

**POSITION DESCRIPTION**

Under the supervision of the Programs Manager, the incumbent will provide administrative, logistical, and operational support throughout the project lifecycle with a particular focus on alumni recruitment and coordination, project administration, production logistics, reporting, communications, database management, and stakeholder engagement.

The Programs Assistant will support the implementation and monitoring of project activities by conducting field visits to project sites, including tapping sites, assisting line management with project follow-up, and documentation, and providing logistical and procurement support for development and institutional projects.

The Programs Assistant will contribute to the smooth implementation or project activities by maintaining accurate project records, coordinating with alumni and relevant stakeholders across Jordan, and supporting content production, and dissemination activities. The incumbent will also assist with the preparation of project records, the maintenance of databases, and the coordination of project-related logistics, in accordance with established procedures and the guidance of the Programs Manager.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Alumni Recruitment & Participant Management**

- Support the implementation of alumni outreach and recruitment activities
- Assist with the administration of the project registration/application process
- Review and organize alumni submissions and supporting documents
- Maintain and regularly update participant databases
- Conduct participant outreach via phone, email, and WhatsApp
- Schedule and coordinate interviews, meetings, filming sessions, and follow-up communications
- Assist with collecting participant consent forms and media release forms
- Maintain accurate records of participant engagement and communications

**Production & Logistics Coordination**

- Assist with coordination between alumni, Amideast staff, and the production company
- Coordinate filming schedules with participants and production teams under the guidance of the Programs Manager Assist in organizing travel schedules for project staff, alumni and production crews
- Prepare schedules, briefing materials, contact sheets, and logistics plans
- Maintain records of production progress and follow up on outstanding activities with relevant parties

**Program Administration**

- Maintain project files and documentation in accordance with Amideast standards and procedures
- Organize project correspondence and records
- Assist in preparing meeting agendas, recording meeting minutes, and updating action-item trackers
- Provide administrative support for procurement and contracting processes, as required
- Assist with invoice tracking and administrative documentation
- Support preparation of internal progress updates and reports by collecting and organizing relevant information

**Project Follow-up and Reporting Support**

- Maintain project trackers and participant databases and ensure that information is accurate and up to date
- Collect, compile, and organize information required for project reporting
- Track story production milestones and dissemination status
- Compile content performance information provided by the production company, as required
- Assist in documenting project, achievements, success stories, and lessons learned under the guidance of the Programs Manager

**Communications & Stakeholder Coordination**

- Support communication with:
- U.S. Embassy representatives
- Exchange program alumni
- Media production partners
- Internal Amideast departments
- Draft routine emails and participant communications for review, as appropriate
- Assist with content collection and project documentation
- Support the coordination of approval processes and the exchange of documents among relevant stakeholders

**Archive & Asset Management**

- Maintain organized digital archives for all project materials
- Track receipt of:
- Final videos
- Photographs
- Raw footage
- Audio files
- Consent forms
- Production documentation
- Ensure that project materials are properly stored, organized, and accessible to authorized personnel

**General Duties:**

- Communicate and coordinate frequently, accurately, and responsibly with Amideast’s office in Amman and program staff
- Demonstrate professional conduct and communicate in a manner consistent with Amideast’s mission of strengthening partnerships and mutual understanding
- Follow Amideast’s policies, standard operating procedures, and established administrative processes
- Support day-to-day communication with designated representatives of Amideast’s corporate clients, as assigned
- Coordinate with relevant departments, including External Relations, to support the promotion of Amideast’s programs, products, and services Perform any other Amideast work-related duties requested by the Programs Manager and/or Country Director, including providing administrative and logistical support to other departments as required

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

***Required***

- A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, International Relations, Media Studies or a related field
- A minimum of 1 year of relevant experience
- English proficiency at B2 level or above, in accordance with the (CEFR Level Alignment)
- Proficiency in Arabic (speaking and writing)
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team
- Computer literacy in MS Office and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets forms and drive)
- Ability to multitask and prioritize responsibilities
- Excellent oral communication and interpersonal skills
- Basic problem-solving and decision-making skills
- Good organizational skills and attention to detail Effective time-management skills
- Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
- Dependable, approachable, and professional in conduct and communication
- Service-oriented, with a proactive approach to assisting colleagues, participants, and stakeholders
- A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and a positive approach to work
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information responsibly

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The incumbent in this position will work in a professional office environment and will utilize the following equipment when working from the corporate office or remote home office (either on a full time, temporary, or hybrid basis).

- Computer (laptop or desktop)
- Printer/Photocopier/Scanner/Fax
- Telephone
- Other (Specify if any)

Up to 20% business travel may be needed to support the two programs as needed.

The physical demands and work environment that have been described is representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position description is an overview of the major functions and requirements of this position. This document is not intended to be an exhaustive list encompassing every duty and requirement of the position; the Employee’s Manager may assign other duties as related or as otherwise deemed appropriate and necessary within the general scope, without the need for additional compensation.

Amideast is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Positions that involve interaction with children will be required to read, acknowledge, and comply with and attend special training in accordance with the Child Protection and Safeguarding policy. All Amideast representatives must comply with the Code of Conduct and all applicable organizational policies which include but are not limited to, Anti-Human Trafficking and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse.

**Amideast provides covered training opportunities for its staff within its current portfolio of offered services and that it invests in the advancement of its staff’s capabilities and skills to better perform at their roles.**

**Please note only the shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Interviews will be conducted on rolling basis and the vacancy will be closed when filled.**

jobs.title: Diseño y Formulación de la Estrategia de Recaudación de Fondos y establecer los vacíos de financiación ActionAid Guatemala
jobs.description:
**1. PROPÓSITO Y CONTEXTO DE LA CONVOCATORIA**
ActionAid Guatemala se basa en 3 principios estructurales que son: Feminista: para abordar las
desigualdades de género en el acceso y uso del poder y otras formas de discriminación, en razón de la
clase social, la raza, la identidad étnica y la orientación sexual; Justa: para asegurar que se enfrenten y
erradiquen las desigualdades y no se deje atrás a nadie; y Verde: para promover el equilibrio sostenible
entre nuestras necesidades y los derechos y necesidades de las futuras generaciones y el respeto hacia
todas las formas de vida.
El objetivo principal de esta consultoría es diseñar y formular la Estrategia General de Recaudación de
Fondos y establecer los vacíos de financiación. Esta herramienta dotará a la organización de una hoja de
ruta ágil, innovadora y éticamente alineada con la defensa de los derechos de la niñez, juventudes y
mujeres en Guatemala.
**2. ENFOQUES ESTRATÉGICOS PRIORITARIOS**
*Justicia de Género y Derechos*
Garantizar el financiamiento sostenible para programas enfocados en los derechos de las mujeres, la niñez y el empoderamiento de colectivos comunitarios.
*Justicia Climática*
Apalancar fondos internacionales e iniciativas globales orientadas a la resiliencia comunitaria y la gobernanza local ante el cambio climático.
**3. ALCANCE GENERAL DEL SERVICIO**
La consultoría abarcará cuatro dimensiones clave:
*Diagnóstico de Oportunidades:* Mapeo de tendencias nacionales e internacionales de cooperación pública y privada.
*Análisis de Capacidad Interna:* Evaluación multidimensional (FODA) y capacidad de absorción de fondos de ActionAid.
*Mapeo y Segmentación:* Perfilamiento de al menos 6 donantes institucionales y mecanimos alternativos.
*Plan de Acción Trienal:* Formulación del plan operativo, escenarios financieros (2027-2029) y 3 notas de concepto.
**4. PERFIL REQUERIDO (HABILIDADES Y EXPERIENCIA)**
*Formación Académica:*
Licenciatura o Maestría en Relaciones Internacionales, Ciencias Sociales, Administración de Proyectos, Desarrollo Internacional o áreas afines.
*Experiencia Comprobada:*
Mínimo de 5 años de experiencia demostrable en formulación de propuestas, gestión de fondos y negociación con donantes de alto valor.
*Conocimientos Técnicos:*
Ciclo de proyectos de cooperación internacional, requisitos financieros y normativos de agencias multilaterales y bilaterales.
*Habilidades Clave:*
Análisis político, lectura del contexto nacional/regional, excelente redacción técnica y negociación a nivel institucional.
**5. PRODUCTOS ESPERADOS (ENTREGABLES)**
Entregable Descripción del Producto
***Producto 1*** Plan de trabajo detallado y cronograma metodológico de la consultoría.
***Producto 2*** Diagnóstico de oportunidades, tendencias de cooperación y mapeo de recursos y alianzas.
***Producto 3*** Documento preliminar de la Estrategia de Recaudación de Fondos y establecer los vacíos de financiación para validación.
***Producto 4*** Presentación y entrega del documento final consolidado y aprobado por ActionAid Guatemala.

jobs.title: LOGISTICS (Procurement) Assistant
jobs.company: Agency for Technical Cooperation and Development
jobs.description:
**About ACTED**

“ We go the last mile. Founded in Afghanistan, against the backdrop of a forgotten crisis, Acted’s mission is to save lives and support people in meeting their needs in hard-to-reach areas. Millions of vulnerable people around the world need humanitarian assistance today, and hundreds of millions will need it tomorrow, in the face of the growing threat of climate change. We believe that our assistance must be conceptualised and delivered within the framework of people’s natural environments, and the territories on which they depend. Therefore, Acted pursues a triple mandate as a humanitarian, environmental and development aid actor, contributing to the relief, stabilisation, and recovery of crisis-affected people in fragile areas. This vision is guided by the motto “Think Local – Act Global” - reflecting the need to rely on a deep understanding of local territories and contexts to develop and implement actions based on local knowledge, structures and capacities. This local thinking contributes to a global response - running through all Acted programming and operations - as we work together towards the building of a 3ZERO world: a world with Zero Exclusion, Zero Carbon, and Zero Poverty”.

**Greening strategy:**

Acted’s greening strategy aims to tackle environmental degradation and climate change while meeting the needs of the most vulnerable who are often those most affected by the deepening environmental crisis. Each Acted employee will adhere to these principles through key green programming responsibilities:

- Contribute towards the adherence and development of the greening strategy plan.
- Explore innovative green programming opportunities and/or solutions within your realm of responsibilities and roles
- Encouraging and promoting environmental safeguarding processes and environmental programming standards in accordance with SOPs and technical guideline notes

**Acted PSEAH Policy:**

The Logistics Assistant has the responsibility to adhere to the PSEAH Policy (Protection against Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment). The Logistics Assistant has the obligation to complete all mandatory trainings related to the Code of Conduct and the PSEA policy and report any safeguarding concern such as breaches of organisational policies or codes of conduct according to Acted’s procedures. The Logistics Assistant carries out work duties in a way that does not harm children, vulnerable adults or other staff or volunteers.

**Location:** Damascus – Syria

**Start Date:** ASAP

**Chain of Command**

Under the authority of:

Country Logistics Manager

**Line Management:**

Senior Logistics Officer

**Working Relations**

Internal:

\- Logistics Department

\- Finance Department

\- Compliance Department

-HR & Admin department

External:

\- Suppliers, contractors.

**Job Purpose:**

Under the supervision of the Logistics Officer/Senior Officer, the Logistic Assistant (Syria) is responsible for supporting all procurement processes under his/her area. The Logistic Assistant may be asked to supervise various aspects of the logistics department or focus on one activity. This will depend on the team structure at the Capital Office. However, all Logistic staff are expected to cover others and be aware of the procedures for all aspects of the logistic operations.

**Objectives**

- Contribute to timely, cost efficient & transparent supply chain management in country.
- Contribute to timely, cost efficient & transparent transversal logistical management in country.
- Ensure compliance to ACTED & donors’ procedures in all logistics operations under his/her responsibility and actively promote logistics procedures.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

1. **Procurement:**

- Managing Tender Inbox:
- In collaboration with the Senior Logistics Manager and Logistics (Senior) Officer, prepare Tender documents
- Ensure 100% of the documentation is correctly filed in hard-copy and electronic-copy and the Bid register ready with each opening session.
- Supporting the Logistics (Senior) Officer for their area in the preparation and follow up of all ongoing procurement.
- Maintaining the Supplier Database (**PRO-03.1**) for ACTED Syria, identifying new sources for common commodities.
- Preparing purchase documents (PMs/POs/Contracts) for purchases for review by the procurement committee.
- Ensure 100% of procurement documentation is correctly filed in hard-copy and electronic-copy and registered on the Order Form Follow-Up (OFFU).
- On occasion the Logistics Assistant (Amman) may be requested to provide procurement support to other Areas of ACTED Syria.

**2. Stock:**
- Review Stock receptions and completion certificates for contracts inside Syria, ensuring that adequate proof of completion and stock receptions are prepared in advance of payment.
- Check all the WASH payments each month and submitted to finance in a hard copy, also update the WASH tracker each month.

**3. Filing:**
- Create separate folders for each reporting documents and file 100% of hard-copy documentation for each procurement.
- For procurement under his/her direct responsibility, ensure soft copies of 100% of all documents produced in the Capital Office are electronically filed in the correct location on ACTED’s database.
- Follow-up on transmission of original and soft-copy documentation to Compliance according to defined timelines and audit schedules.
- Assists Logistics department as needed on administrative tasks such as printing and scanning Logistics documents.
- Support logistics team in handling the tender process.
- Prepare tender opening folders with all updated offers. prior to tender opening day

**4. Reporting:**
- Register 100% of new orders on the Capital Order Form Follow-Up (OFFU) and record the progress of each procurement until the completed file is transferred to Finance for payment.
- Participate in other reporting upon delegation of his/her manager.
- Supplier’s screening.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

the key performance indicator (KPI) is a measurable value that demonstrates how effectively a company is achieving key business objectives. Organizations use KPIs to evaluate their success at reaching targets

- % success rate of daily tasks on time
- % of tasks achieved in a timely manner;
- % of reports submitted in a timely manner;
- Number of folders prepared
- Number of successful procurements under his/her direct responsibility completed & delivered on-time, in-full.
- Accuracy of logistics OFFU, WASH trackers & TITANIC report.
- General conclusion of internal audit reports on logistics aspects assigned to the Logistics Assistant (% compliance incidents compared to ACTED Logistics Manual and procedures).

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

- University Degree from recognized university in any field.
- Fluent English and Arabic (written and spoken);
- Excellent writing and communication skills;
- At least 1 years’ work experience with an INGO in similar position as Logistics Assistant.
- Ability to work under pressure in a high-pace environment;
- Good organisational and prioritisation skills;
- Strong interpersonal skills
- Strong analytical skills
- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
- Diligent, dedicated, and able to see complex procedures through to completion.
- Able to communicate complex information clearly, with excellent interpersonal skills.
- Self-motivated, able to work independently or as part of a team.
- Excellent computer skills including Microsoft Office (particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word), and files transfer systems.

jobs.title: Oficial de Recuperación Económica (Medios de Vida) - Maracaibo
jobs.description:
El Consejo Dánes para refugiados es una de las ONG humanitarias líderes en el mundo, que trabaja en más de 40 países para brindar asistencia y protección adecuadas a refugiados, solicitantes de asilo, desplazados internos, retornados, personas en movimiento y población local vulnerable/comunidades de acogida. Actualmente, DRC está buscando un **Oficial de Recuperación Económica (Medios de Vida)** altamente calificado con sede en **Maracaibo, Edo. Zulia.**

**Acerca del trabajo:**

DRC está administrando sus operaciones en Venezuela, bajo la dirección de la oficina de país en Caracas y tres oficinas de campo ubicadas en los estados de Sucre, Apure y Zulia. DRC Venezuela está implementando actividades como monitoreo de protección, asistencia legal, asistencia de protección individual para PWSN, sesiones informativas para PoC, prevención de trata de personas, rehabilitación de infraestructura de salud y seguridad alimentaria

**Objetivo del cargo**

Bajo la supervisión del/la Team Leader de Recuperación Económica o del Gerente de Recuperación Económica, el/la Oficial de Recuperación Económica será responsable de implementar de manera efectiva y oportuna las actividades del componente de medios de vida de los programas de Recuperación Económica de DRC en Venezuela. Esto incluye el acompañamiento técnico en terreno para el fortalecimiento de emprendedores y micronegocios en comunidades vulnerables, expuestas a riesgos de protección y desastres, así como el desarrollo de habilidades blandas para emprender, la integración del enfoque verde en sus modelos de negocio y su articulación con oportunidades de mercado. Asimismo, el/la Oficial facilitará la transferencia de metodologías de formación a socios locales a través de metodologías desarrolladas por DRC, y garantizará la correcta recopilación de los medios de verificación necesarios para el seguimiento y la rendición de cuentas.

El/la Oficial promoverá una programación integrada y articulada con los equipos de Protección, WASI y Preparación para Desastres, asegurando intervenciones intersectoriales y de calidad en todas las etapas del proyecto. Además, será responsable de coordinar efectivamente con el equipo de Recuperación Económica y socios locales, y de asegurar el cumplimiento del plan de acción establecido.

**Responsabilidades:**

**Identificación de actividades propias del sector de Medios de Vida**

- Liderar diagnósticos socioeconómicos y de mercado para identificar cadenas productivas, ecosistemas de actores claves del sector público y privado, y oportunidades de inclusión financiera (instituciones, banca, sector privado) que fomenten la autosuficiencia y resiliencia de las Personas de Interés (PDI).
- Evaluar la viabilidad técnica, social, ambiental y económica de propuestas productivas, asegurando que los proyectos de medios de vida sean sostenibles, pertinentes culturalmente y sensibles a los riesgos de
- protección y desastres.
- Contribuir con datos del contexto local para el ajuste y formulación de propuestas, garantizando la integración del enfoque de Recuperación Económica con otros sectores (Protección, WASI) y Preparación para Desastres).
- Con el apoyo y la orientación de su supervisor y coordinación técnica, sugerir ideas innovadoras y técnicas adecuadas para las intervenciones de Recuperación Económica en función del contexto.

**Implementación técnica y logística**

- Responsable de implementar la planificación, ejecución, seguimiento y cierre técnico de las actividades de medios de vida (focalización, diagnósticos, selección, formación, entregas, encuestas PDM, líneas base/salida y gestión de bases de datos), en coordinación con el Team Leader o Gerente de Recuperación económica, y con los equipos de Logística y finanzas para asegurar el cumplimiento del plan de acción y el reporte oportuno de los indicadores propuestos.
- Diseñar e implementar procesos de formación en planes de negocios, medios de vida verdes, orientación vocacional, habilidades blandas, planes de marketing, estructuras de costos, gestión y educación financiera, mediante metodologías híbridas que incluyen plataformas digitales (Moodle). Entre las actividades se contempla la facilitación directa, la Formación a Formadores (ToT) para socios y la gestión logística/financiera necesaria para su ejecución.
- Con la orientación técnica de la coordinación de Recuperación Económica, en conjunto con la supervisión del Team Leader o Gerente de Recuperación Económica, ser el punto focal de alianzas estratégicas con actores del sector privado, público o institucional para actividades propias de medios de vida, como lo pueden ser alianzas estratégicas para emprendedores.
- Realizar planes de seguimiento a las PdI relacionados al incremento de su productividad y de medición de indicadores establecidos en el programa de Recuperación Económica.
- Identificar, coordinar y entregar apoyos en especie (como insumos productivos, herramientas, equipos, etc.) de acuerdo con las necesidades socioeconómicas y productivas identificadas, así como con los lineamientos técnicos de la coordinación y el enfoque de protección.
- Participar en la preparación de informes mensuales/trimestrales/anuales aportando análisis técnicos sobre el componente y las actividades realizadas, así como en la orientación técnica para elaborar presupuestos de este componente en formulaciones de proyectos.
